name: XLRS-Bench
intro: XLRS-Bench是一个综合性基准，用于评估多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在超高分辨率遥感场景中的感知和推理能力。该基准拥有迄今为止最大的平均图像尺寸（8500x8500），所有评估样本都经过人工精心标注，并辅以新颖的半自动标注器。XLRS-Bench定义了16个子任务，旨在评估MLLMs的10种感知能力和6种推理能力，重点关注促进实际决策和捕捉时空变化的先进认知过程。
org: National University of Defense Technology, Tsinghua University, Wuhan University, Beijing University
task_type: 多模态问答, 感知与推理
eval_feature: 超高分辨率, 人工标注, 复杂推理
task_type_en: Multimodal Question Answering, Perception and Reasoning
eval_feature_en: Ultra-high Resolution, Human Annotation, Complex Reasoning
intro_en: XLRS-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the perception and reasoning abilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in ultra-high-resolution remote sensing scenarios. It features the largest average image size to date (8500x8500), with all evaluation samples meticulously annotated by humans and supplemented by a novel semi-automatic annotator. XLRS-Bench defines 16 subtasks aimed at assessing 10 perception capabilities and 6 reasoning abilities of MLLMs, focusing on advanced cognitive processes that facilitate practical decision-making and capture spatiotemporal changes.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with XLRS-Bench arXiv:2503.23771v1, Figures 3-4, Sections 3.1-3.3 and 4.1-4.2, Tables 2-4, and Appendix A.4 Table 5; project https://xlrs-bench.github.io/home_page.html, repository https://github.com/AI9Stars/XLRS-Bench, and release collection https://huggingface.co/collections/initiacms/xlrs-bench. Version pin: full-paper 1,400-image bilingual benchmark, not the earlier VQA-only lite release or website scale_en=10,784. Required conflict: repeated headline total is 45,942, while literal Appendix Table 5 rows sum to 45,838.. XLRS-Bench combines 1,400 ultra-high-resolution images from six remote-sensing sources, applies multi-round human cross-validation, and creates three products: 13-task all-human VQA, two-task human grounding, and GPT-4o-assisted captions refined by humans using VQA evidence. Six bilingual experts translate and cross-check long-form content. Evaluation routes VQA to accuracy/OLUC exact-set match, grounding to Acc@IoU 0.5/0.7, and captions to BLEU/METEOR/ROUGE-L. The diagram must disclose the 45,942 headline versus 45,838 Table-5 sum conflict.
